Mothership ingests real Avata360 OSV files. Their lens calibration is under top.2.5 fields 3/4, their extrinsic quaternion is nested at field 26, and some files carry an all-zero legacy field-21 quaternion placeholder that must fall through to field 26. Optional telemetry fields may also use different wire types. The decoder preserves the pinned Osmo layout while accepting the Avata layout and ignoring incompatible optional telemetry instead of aborting conversion.
